messages:
mira: Quick check — onboarding weights for the new 40B model. CI failed with tokenizer mismatch. I pulled artifact at /mnt/artifacts/ci/1742/mosaic-40b-q8.tar.gz and used tokenizer.json from that tar. Can someone confirm canonical weight/tokenizer paths?
rafael: Canonical: s3://prod-models/redwood/mosaic-v1/40b/pt/ . Quant outputs are under s3://prod-models/redwood/mosaic-v1/40b/quant/*. If CI used /tmp or a staging tar, it's probably an outdated tokenizer. What exact path did CI reference?
mira: CI referenced /mnt/artifacts/ci/1742/mosaic-40b-q8.tar.gz. Tokenizer inside that tar has vocab size 50268 but model config expects 50272. Quick dump: first 6 tokens: ['<|start|>', '<|end|>', '<|pad|>', ' the', ' of', ' and'] — pad id is 2 while model.json has "pad_token_id": 0.
samir: That explains token-id offsets. Tokenizer roundtrip will break KV alignment. Run the tokenizer roundtrip test and the small rope sanity. Example quick checks:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('hello').ids)"
./bin/rope-check --model-config model.json --max-pos 2048
```
rafael: Also watch out for attn type mismatch (MQA vs GQA). If model.json says "gqa" but weights were converted from an MQA checkpoint, the KV shapes won't line up and runtime will panic on first step. CI logs show a KV shape assertion earlier.
mira: model.json currently: {"attn_type": "gqa", "pad_token_id": 0, "rotary_freq_scale": 1.0} but converter flags used: --attn=mqa --rope-scale=legacy. So we likely have mixed metadata.
samir: Two paths: 1) re-run conversion with correct flags (accurate but expensive for quant), or 2) loader shim to detect kv shapes and transpose mqa<->gqa on load (fast patch). We already have a shim for old rotary table ordering.
rafael: I'll open a tiny loader PR that checks kv_dim and transposes if needed. But we need deterministic test vector to avoid regressions. Mira, can you attach a minimal failing example (input text + expected logits or checksum)?
mira: Pasting minimal failing input: 'The quick brown fox jumps' -> tokenizer ids: [10, 234, 95, 432, 293] (example). Model run crashes at step 1 with assertion: "KV cache shape mismatch: expected (n_heads, seq, head_dim) got (1, seq, head_dim)". Attached: /mnt/artifacts/ci/1742/failure-snippet.json (small).
ops-bot: CI job mosaic-40b-quant/validation failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/1234 — tokenizer mismatch.
rafael: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/2982 — loader: detect kv layout + transpose path. Includes unit test that loads small quant artifact and checks inference for the sample input.
ci-bot: PR 2982 triggered CI: runtime-unit-tests (linux, py39) queued.
ci-bot: runtime-unit-tests failed on first run: flake8 error in tests/test_loader_transpose.py line 42 (bad import).
samir: I'll fix the flake, push a tiny commit. Also, before we land shim, confirm tokenizer canonical path. Mira, please upload the tokenizer from prod S3 to a stable location and re-run quant validation against it.
mira: Uploaded canonical tokenizer to s3://prod-models/redwood/mosaic-v1/40b/tokenizer/tokenizer.json and kicked off CI re-run.
ci-bot: mosaic-40b-quant/validation started (rerun).
rafael: After merge, we should add a validation step in our CI: verify (vocab_size == model.config.vocab_size) and (pad_token_id in vocab or pad_token_id == -1) before accepting artifact. I'll add a small check to converter and CI.
mira: Agreed. Also need to document rope scale expectations: runtime default assumes rotary table precomputed for 2048 positions unless model.json sets "rotary_freq_scale". I'll add a short note in the onboarding checklist.
samir: TL;DR action items: (1) mira -> re-run CI with prod tokenizer (done), (2) rafael -> land loader shim PR + add vocab sanity check, (3) samir -> flake fix + unit tests, (4) ops -> confirm canonical s3 path mapping in release notes.
mira: Thanks all — will report back when validation passes. :thumbsup:
rafael: ping me if CI still fails after loader changes, I can instrument deeper logs.
ci-bot: mosaic-40b-quant/validation succeeded on rerun. Artifacts promoted to prod-bucket.
mira: Awesome, closing loop. I'll open a short internal doc with final paths and the tokenizer/attn checklist.
